title: helianthemum salicifolium var. intermedium
intro: Helianthemum salicifolium var. intermedium, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Cistaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in wound healing and soothing skin irritations. These constituents may also contribute to the plant's potential anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects.
